mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TB_NOTIFICATION ( recipient_user_id, sender_user_id, notification_type, target_type, target_id, source_comment_id ) SELECT recipient.user_id, #{senderUserId}, #{notificationType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{sourceCommentId} FROM TB_USER recipient WHERE recipient.user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND recipient.notify_comment = 1 AND recipient.user_id != #{senderUserId}

INSERT INTO TB_NOTIFICATION ( recipient_user_id, sender_user_id, notification_type, target_type, target_id ) SELECT admin.user_id, #{reporterUserId}, 'REPORT_RECEIVED', 'REPORT', #{reportId} FROM TB_USER admin WHERE admin.role = 'ADMIN' AND admin.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_NOTIFICATION existing WHERE existing.recipient_user_id = admin.user_id AND existing.notification_type = 'REPORT_RECEIVED' AND existing.target_type = 'REPORT' AND existing.target_id = #{reportId} )
